clarifications.title: Income Below Spain DNV Screening Band
clarifications.clarification: Spain DNV screening requires the applicant's gross monthly income to meet at least the minimum qualifying band. Based on the selected income band, the application does not currently appear to meet that financial threshold.

clarifications.title: Foreign-Source Income Not Confirmed
clarifications.clarification: Spain DNV screening requires the income supporting the application to be earned from outside Spain. If the income source is not clearly foreign-sourced, the application does not currently appear to meet this core screening requirement.

clarifications.title: Work Relationship Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The work relationship is missing or not recognized. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed because evidence requirements depend on whether the applicant is an employee, contractor, or business owner.

clarifications.title: Service Agreement Review Needed
clarifications.clarification: Self-employed applicants may need to show business-to-business work relationships through service agreements, contracts, or similar documentation. If those agreements cannot be secured, the case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Income Band Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The income band needed for Spain DNV screening was not recognized. The case should be reviewed manually before an eligibility conclusion is provided.

clarifications.title: Income Duration Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant should be able to document income history for the period needed to support the Spain DNV application. A short, missing, or unrecognized income-history answer should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Income Evidence Incomplete
clarifications.clarification: The income evidence selected does not currently include the expected documents for the applicant's work type. The case should be reviewed to confirm whether alternative documents can support the application.

clarifications.title: Employee Income Evidence Incomplete
clarifications.clarification: Employee applicants should provide employee-specific salary evidence, such as bank statements, an employment contract, and pay stubs. If those documents are incomplete, the case should be reviewed to confirm whether alternative employee evidence can support eligibility.

clarifications.title: Contractor Income Evidence Incomplete
clarifications.clarification: Contractor or self-employed applicants should provide contractor-specific income evidence, such as bank statements, invoices, and service agreements or contracts. If those documents are incomplete, the case should be reviewed to confirm whether alternative contractor evidence can support eligibility.

clarifications.title: Business Owner Income Evidence Incomplete
clarifications.clarification: Business-owner applicants should provide business-specific income evidence, such as bank statements, business registration, and tax returns or financial statements. If those documents are incomplete, the case should be reviewed to confirm whether alternative business evidence can support eligibility.

clarifications.title: Passport Validity Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The passport validity answer is missing or below the screening threshold. The applicant may need to renew the passport or confirm validity before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Police Clearance Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: The applicant may need to provide a criminal background certificate or police clearance. If this document cannot be obtained, the case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Criminal Background Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: A disclosed criminal record should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed. The review should determine whether the record affects the Spain DNV application.

clarifications.title: Health Insurance Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant should have qualifying health insurance or be able to obtain it. If insurance status is unclear, the case should be reviewed.

clarifications.title: Dependent Count Missing
clarifications.clarification: The application should confirm whether any family members are included. Dependent count can affect required documents and income review.

clarifications.title: Dependent Documents Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: When dependents are included, civil or relationship documents may be required. Missing dependent documents should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Civil Documents Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: Spain DNV eligibility screening may require identity, residence, or civil-status documents. If these documents are unavailable, the case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Apostille or Translation Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: Foreign documents may need apostille, legalization, or official Spanish translation. If the applicant cannot prepare these formalities, the case should be reviewed.

clarifications.title: Renewal or Compliance Acknowledgement Missing
clarifications.clarification: Spain DNV approval may involve renewal or ongoing compliance obligations. The applicant should confirm these obligations before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Non-DNV Service Interest
clarifications.clarification: The selected service interest does not appear to be primarily for the Spain Digital Nomad Visa. A team member should review the request and route it to the appropriate tax or advisory follow-up.

clarifications.title: Manual Review Required
clarifications.clarification: The information provided is not enough to confirm Spain DNV eligibility automatically. The case should be reviewed manually so the team can identify the appropriate next step.
